points: Switch with the button next to the logo, which also has **New workspace…**; there can be up to 12 workspaces, and the standard one cannot be deleted.

A new workspace starts with a copy of the current one's settings; accounts and keys, web search, voice engines, messengers, notifications, hotkeys, language and modules stay shared. **Take another workspace's settings** copies the settings and panels of the chosen one.
In an agentic workspace the companion turns on Work and MemuCode by itself, and **Projects** in the sidebar are separate chats for big tasks.
An answer arrives as one to three messages, each whole, with “typing…” in between; companion messages take reactions — the companion sees all of them and may answer with its own.
The companion keeps recent messages verbatim and older ones as summaries and finds what it needs with search; **Context economy** sets the balance between memory and token cost.
In an agentic workspace the Home panels sit in a dock beside the conversation: cards on the right, a slim rail or chips above it.

stuck-detector.tldr: The stuck detector **pauses** MemuAI agents when they repeat the same action, error, or plan step without making progress, preventing wasted steps and money. Use it whenever an agent runs autonomously in Work, Do For You, Browser and Computer Use, MemuCode or MemuCode CLI.
points: When a loop is detected, a pause card appears showing the repeating steps with a "×N" counter and offers **Continue**, **With a hint…**, **Change approach**, and **Stop** buttons.
If nobody answers the pause for 30 minutes, the work stops automatically; in the main window, sending a new chat message also counts as an answer and closes the pause.
Adjust sensitivity under **Settings → Work & agents → Stuck detector → Sensitivity**, where `Normal` is recommended (for example, 4 identical actions or 3 identical errors).
Scrolling and arrow keys receive twice the patience so normal list navigation does not trigger false pauses.
In MemuCode CLI without the interface (`-p`), the turn ends and the goal is paused until you resume it with `/goal continue`.

sync.tldr: Sync backs up your MemuAI data to Google Drive or a folder, automatically or on demand, and lets you restore saved versions. Use it to protect your data or move it to a new PC.
points: Open **Settings → Sync**, choose a Storage, and use Check access to test it.
Set Back up automatically and How often, or enable Back up when MemuAI closes; Only when something changed skips unchanged backups.
Choose which categories to include; downloaded models are excluded, and Keys & tokens require encryption.
Enable **Encrypt backups with a passphrase** to protect backup contents, and remember that a forgotten passphrase makes restoration impossible.
In Restore and the backup list, select a version and categories, then restart MemuAI after restoring; Undo the restore returns affected files to their previous state.

tables-diagrams.tldr: Tables and diagrams in MemuAI are interactive objects you can sort, filter, style, copy, export and edit offline, letting you work with structured data or visualise information directly inside the chat.
points: Hover a table to reveal its toolbar with **Filter** (supports conditions like `price>100`), **Copy**, **Export**, **As an image**, **Fullscreen**, and **Edit and send back to the AI**; click column headers to sort and drag edges to resize columns.

Create your own table via the **"+"** menu → **Table**: use the grid editor, ++Ctrl+V++ to paste from Excel/CSV, import files (`.csv`, `.tsv`, `.txt`, `.md`, `.json`, `.xlsx`), navigate with ++Tab++, ++Enter++, and undo with ++Ctrl+Z++; then **Attach** as a Markdown file or **insert it as text**.

Render a table as an image with the "Table as an image" window, choosing from style presets, background options, text colors, fonts, title/caption, and a 1×–4× **scale**; the last style used is remembered for quick **Copy → As an image** and **Export → PNG**.

Ask the AI to draw charts or schemes, and control their automatic generation in **Settings → Chat & replies → Charts and diagrams** (modes: **Only when really useful**, **Only on request, otherwise offer**, **Off**).

The diagram toolbar offers **Customize**, **Copy as an image**, **Download** (PNG, SVG, and data formats), **Code**, and **Fullscreen** (zoom with ++Ctrl++ + mouse wheel); if a diagram cannot be drawn, an error message appears with a **Code** button and a **Fix with AI** button to request a corrected version.

teams.tldr: Team brings together models with separate roles and a communication manager in regular chats or Work. The manager curates personal context; the lead assigns work and reviews the outcome.
points: Choose a manager and assign members or let the manager recruit them. Work starts after plan approval.
Workers hand results to a reviewer; repairs need lead approval and the manager presents the result. Individual tool failures do not abort the whole run.
Select members to inspect actions and reports. Budgets and concurrency are configurable; hidden reasoning stays private.

telegram.tldr: The Telegram bot mirrors your MemuAI chats, models, profiles and agents on the computer, so you can ask, speak, send files and control chats from Telegram while everything stays synced and private through the local MemuAI Proxy.
points: Connect in **Settings → Messengers → Telegram**: paste a bot token from @BotFather, press **Connect Telegram**, then scan the QR or send the pairing code to the bot.
The bot answers only your paired chat (plus users in “Additional users”); the token stays on your computer and never reaches logs.
Use voice messages, video notes or audio files for speech-to-text via the local Whisper model, and send photos for vision or PDF/DOCX/text files for reading.
Control chats with buttons like **💬 Chats**, **➕ New chat**, **☰ Menu**, and commands such as `/new`, `/temp`, `/stop`, `/retry`, `/image`, `/video`, `/web`.
If the bot is silent, check the status in the panel: start MemuAI Proxy for “MemuAI Proxy is not running”, press **Restart bot** for “The bot is not responding”, or re-pair the chat if needed.

telegram-miniapp.tldr: The Telegram Mini App turns MemuAI into a Telegram app, letting you control chats, agents, MemuCode, modules, and settings from your phone while everything runs on your computer.
points: Enable it in **Settings → Messengers → Telegram** under the **Mini App — MemuAI in Telegram** card, then wait for the status to read **Online**.
Open it via the **menu button** in the bot chat or the **Open MemuAI** inline button; in a regular browser, sign in with a QR code or the `/web` link.
Chats, agents, MemuCode, modules, and settings work from the phone, but features needing the computer (Work, tools, image generation, Live voice) are not offered.
Voice input uses the local Whisper model on the computer; without it, the button is dimmed and explains how to install one in **MemuAI → Settings → Voice & Live**.
For a permanent address, use an **Own tunnel** or **Own URL**; the quick Cloudflare tunnel changes address on every start.

themes.tldr: Custom themes let you change MemuAI’s appearance with a `.css` file that appears alongside built-in variants in light or dark mode. Use the theme studio for visual editing and readability checks, the theme editor for changes on the live interface, or a text editor for full control.
points: Open Settings → Appearance → Custom themes → Create theme to use the studio; ++Ctrl+S++ saves and applies the theme.
Open the theme editor with ++Ctrl+Shift+U++ to edit the live interface; Save keeps changes, while ++Esc++ discards unsaved edits.
Start from the closest built-in base: a theme stores only your changes and inherits the rest.
For a hand-written theme, open Themes folder, save a `.css` file with `@base` set to `dark` or `light`, and return to MemuAI to reload it.
Choose Use on a theme card to apply it; if the interface becomes unreadable, pick a built-in variant in Settings → Appearance.

themes-reference.tldr: **Tokens** and **selectors** let you customize the MemuAI interface by changing CSS variables for colours, shapes, fonts, and syntax highlighting. Use them when building a custom theme or making targeted visual adjustments.
points: Main tokens like `--bg`, `--text`, and `--accent` control core interface colours, while additional tokens such as `--side-bg` and `--user-bubble` allow changes to specific parts without affecting the rest.
Shape and font tokens including `--radius`, `--conversation-width`, and `--sans` define corner radii, layout widths, and typefaces across the app.
Syntax highlighting variables like `--tok-kw` and `--tok-str` override code colouring per variant, with unset values falling back to the base palette.
The `<html>` element carries attributes such as `data-theme`, `data-accent`, and `data-density` that themes can target to apply conditional styles.
Stable selectors like `.composer`, `#messages`, and `aside.side` are safe to use in custom CSS, whereas unlisted selectors are internal and may change between versions.

transfer.tldr: Moving data lets you export, import, and back up your chats, personal information, memes, modules, and themes so you can switch assistants or computers.
points: In **Settings → Data**, click **Export all chats** to save the full profile history as a JSON file in `Downloads\MemuAI`.
Use **Import chats** in the same section to load histories from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or a MemuAI export; tick **Replace all current chats** to clear existing history first.

Transfer an assistant’s knowledge of you with **Import information about yourself** by copying the prompt, sending it to the source assistant, pasting the answer back, selecting a processing model, reviewing the facts, and saving.
Export and import memes as `*.memu-agent.json` files via **Export memes** and **Import memes**; you’ll be prompted to choose a model on import.
To move everything—including accounts, settings, profiles, and Proxy models—copy the `%APPDATA%\MemuAI` folder while MemuAI and the Proxy are closed (do not place this folder in a shared cloud).

troubleshooting.tldr: Troubleshooting helps you diagnose and fix MemuAI issues with responses, accounts, images, voice, MemuCode and startup. Start with the Proxy log and restart services, then follow the guidance for your symptom.
points: Open Proxy → Logs to find the cause of a request error, and use Ask AI next to it for a plain-language explanation.
Use Proxy → Home → Restart services to rebuild connections without closing the program, especially after waking your laptop or changing networks.
For account errors, refresh the cookie after signing in again for 401 or 403; for 429, wait or add a second account.
Press ++Ctrl+R++ to reload an odd-looking interface without losing data.
If nothing helps, collect the Proxy log error, the Server log tab and, for a failed start, `startup-error.log`; these logs exclude cookies and keys and are safe to share.

voice.tldr: Voice and MemuAI Live combine dictation, transcript cleanup, reading replies aloud and voice conversations. Voice & Live settings select local engines or cloud services and a separate real-time model mode.
points: Dictation can use a downloaded local Whisper model or a transcription service. Each service keeps its own address, key and model; a selected audio file can test the setup.
Optional post-processing fixes punctuation and speech slips while preserving meaning. Dictated text remains editable before sending.
Replies can use Windows voices, downloaded Piper voices or speech APIs. Replay uses a cache, and a separate speech-process failure does not close MemuAI.
Classic Live chains transcription, chat and synthesis. Real-time models listen and speak directly; camera, screen sharing and search support depend on the provider.
Conversations are saved as voice messages with transcripts and players. Long turns retain the first three minutes of audio; temporary chats keep recordings until closed.
Live personality takes priority over ordinary tone; changing it during a call reconnects the session. Cloud services use their own keys, quotas and prices.

web-search.tldr: Web search gives models fresh information beyond their training date, useful for news, rates, timetables and documentation of new versions. MemuAI can use a model’s built-in search or pass external search results to any text model.
points: Enable search for the current chat with the top-bar toggle or `/search on`; an `@Web` mention suggests checking the internet for a particular question.
Use **Settings → Web search → Enable by default** for new chats, but remember that the chat toggle takes precedence and the model still decides whether search is needed.
Choose Automatic, Built-in only or Custom only under Settings → Web search → Search source, and right-click the chat toggle to choose the source from the chat.
Configure external services under Settings → Web search → External source → Service, then use Test the source to check results and speed; API keys stay on this computer.
Configure search for third-party API programs separately under Proxy → Settings → Web search, which works independently of MemuAI’s settings.

welcome.tldr: MemuAI is a Windows desktop application that unifies cloud AI accounts (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok) and local models into one window for conversations, files, voice, memory and scheduling. Use it when you want to manage all your AI services and offline models from a single interface.
points: **MemuAI** is the chat window for conversations, Work, MemuCode and settings, while **MemuAI Proxy** runs in the tray as the background engine that stores accounts and serves the API.
Start by following the setup order: install the program, connect at least one service or local model via Accounts, learn the Interface, then begin using Chats and Models.
Search the documentation with the field at the top left or the ++/++ key, navigate history with ++Alt+←++ and ++Alt+→++, and select any text to ask MemuAI about it directly.
All chats, settings, memory and accounts are stored locally on your computer in `%APPDATA%\MemuAI`, and messages are sent only to the selected service or stay entirely offline for local models.
The app includes specialized sections like Agents for parallel tasks, MemuCode for programmers, Voice for dictation and live conversation, and Modules for custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript apps.

work.tldr: **Work** is the mode where the model reads, writes, and edits files within a single chosen project folder on your computer. Use it for documents, texts, small sites, and scripts by clicking the **Work** button in the sidebar or typing `/work`.
points: Add folders with the ＋ button on the Work bar; each project has its own chats, and the model sees only files inside that folder.
Choose between **Ask for approval** (default) and **Full access** via the Work bar switch or `/access`; changes are always visible in chat.
Use **Plan** (`/plan` or `@Plan`) to make the model outline verifiable steps before working, or **Goal** (`/goal <goal>`) for autonomous step-by-step execution up to 12 turns.
Keep **Confirm CLI commands** enabled in Settings → Work & agents so the model asks before running commands with your Windows account rights.
Reference specific files directly with `@path`, and use the preview panel on the right when the model creates web pages.
